meta.title: Who really said "I'm selfish, impatient and a little insecure. I make mistakes, I am out of control and at times hard to handle. But if you can't handle me at my worst, then you sure as hell don't deserve me at my best"? | Quotle.info
meta.description: No. This popular line is misattributed to Marilyn Monroe — Wikiquote and Snopes find no source; its origin is genuinely unknown.

meta.ogDescription: No. This popular line is misattributed to Marilyn Monroe — Wikiquote and Snopes find no source; its origin is genuinely unknown.

answer.label: Not Marilyn Monroe — an unsourced modern aphorism
answer.sourceLine: There is no record of Marilyn Monroe ever saying or writing this. Wikiquote files it under “Misattributed” as a quotation “of unknown origin and date,” and Snopes found no evidence she said it. It reads as an internet-era self-help line retro-fitted onto her name.

source.heading: The trail runs cold

docMeta.dd: None — no interview, letter, or book
Undocumented; circulates only on quote sites & social media

source.excerpt: I'm selfish, impatient and a little insecure. I make mistakes, I am out of control and at times hard to handle. But if you can't handle me at my worst, then you sure as hell don't deserve me at my best.
trail: Wikiquote places the line in its Misattributed section, describing it as attributed to Monroe in self-help books and on social media but “of unknown origin and date.”
Snopes investigated the short form (“if you can't handle me at my worst…”) and reported it could not find the original source and found no evidence Monroe said it.
Even aggregators flag it: the Goodreads entry carries reader tags such as “misattributed-marilyn-monroe” and “attributed-no-source.”
source.excerptNote: Widely reproduced on Goodreads, Pinterest and merchandise under Monroe’s name — but with no citation to any speech, interview, or page she ever produced.
source.rightsNote: Because the exact wording cannot be tied to any identified author or first publication, no copyright status can be responsibly asserted. Monroe died in 1962 and this line appears in none of her documented works, so it is neither demonstrably her estate’s nor demonstrably public domain — its origin is simply unknown.

author.name: Marilyn Monroe
author.heading: About Marilyn Monroe
author.bio: Marilyn Monroe (born Norma Jeane Mortenson, 1926–1962) was one of Hollywood’s most enduring stars, famed for films such as Some Like It Hot and Gentlemen Prefer Blondes. Decades after her death she became one of the internet’s most powerful magnets for feel-good, empowerment, and heartbreak quotes — a great many of which, like this one, she never actually said.

copyAttribution: Misattributed to Marilyn Monroe — actual origin unknown. No source connects this line to her (Wikiquote; Snopes).

misattribution.heading: A meme in Monroe’s mouth
misattribution.intro: This is one of the most-shared “Marilyn Monroe” quotes on the internet — and one of the least supported. No primary source connects it to her.

items.why: Wikiquote lists it under Misattributed, calling it a quotation “of unknown origin and date” that spread through “self-help books and on social media.”

items.scope: The short form (“…at my worst…at my best”)
items.why: Snopes could not locate any original source and found no evidence Monroe ever said it.

misattribution.truthLine: The honest answer is that nobody knows who wrote it: it is an unsourced modern aphorism attached to Monroe’s name for the glamour, per Wikiquote and Snopes.

context.heading: Why it sticks to her
lead: The line pairs a confessional list of flaws with a defiant boundary — exactly the blend of vulnerability and glamour the popular image of Monroe evokes. That resonance, not any documentary record, is why it gets pinned to her.

Its real spread is a social-media phenomenon: it circulates on Pinterest boards, mugs, and Goodreads long after Monroe’s 1962 death, with the attribution copied from post to post and never traced to a source.
context.pull: Widely quoted, universally uncited — a modern aphorism wearing a movie star’s name.
